_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Chemistry Syllabus (5070), Grade 10-12' (2013, published by CDC) — Grade 12, Topics 12.9-12.12. Topic, sub-topic and Specific Outcome statements only; the 'Content' column is omitted for the reasons documented in the Grade 10 file. This matches the Grade's own general-outcomes statement, which names exactly four areas: electricity and chemistry, metals, non-metals, and organic chemistry. Unusually, Grade 12's topic numbering jumps straight from Grade 11's 11.4 to 12.9 (skipping 12.1-12.8 entirely) — a genuine oddity in the source's own numbering scheme, not a transcription error; Grade 12's own topics from 12.9 onward are internally consistent and reliably numbered. A few outcome codes within Grade 12 sub-topics skip individual digits (e.g. under 12.11.2 Hydrogen and 12.11.3 Oxygen); outcomes are numbered sequentially here in the source's own reading order rather than reproducing those gaps. The syllabus organizes content by Grade only, not by Term, so all of Grade 12 is modeled as a single term here. Pages following the Grade 12 content (from the syllabus's own page 83 onward) are the 'Chemistry Practical Syllabus' appendix — practical techniques, apparatus and reagent lists, and qualitative analysis test notes — not further curriculum content, confirming this is the complete topic set.
